verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Asana's API rate limits, automation-rule quotas, or what happens when a plan's limits are exceeded (overage charges, throttling/429 responses, or a hard stop). The mention of agent 'cost constraints' and spend management is a related governance control, not documented over-limit behavior, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
